desc:

The competitive drawing game with a fun multiplayer twist! 🎨
The clock is ticking, and it’s time to Speed Draw!

Challenge your friends to make the coolest artwork! Become a pro artist! 

🎉 UPDATE 04/22

🆕 New Features:
* Gallery: view drawings from the previous round 🖼️
* Stabilizer Tool (use with Brush or Watercolor + 🔧 wrench)
* Increased server size (8 ➡️ 12 players)
* Fair voting system (everyone starts with ⭐ 1 star)
* New themes
* Bug fixes

❤️ If you enjoy the game, please leave a like!

👍 BIG UPDATE at 650,000 likes

🖌️ Controls:
* Zoom: mouse wheel or pinch screen
* Move camera: click/touch and drag with no tool selected
* Equip tools: keys 1–7 or touchscreen

⬅️ Undo: Z
➡️ Redo: Y

❗ Free Custom Themes available in private servers

Special thanks to zuffhy!

scripts.title: Speed draw sceipt
scripts.script:
local msg = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Game.Message
local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local ps = Enum.KeyCode.Print

while true do
	while not msg.Visible do wait() end
	while msg.Visible do wait() end
	vim:SendKeyEvent(true, ps, false, game)
    vim:SendKeyEvent(false, ps, false, game)
end
